name: David Robitaille
bio: David Robitaille is a Canadian director and producer who bridges the Montreal and Hollywood markets as a member of the Academy of Canadian Cinema & Television. Mentored by industry veteran Richard Graves, Robitaille has established a reputation for executive maturity, successfully directing complex, union-compliant productions by age 21. He is currently focused on developing IP and screenplays for American production entities, specializing in a directorial style that integrates high-level production infrastructure with authentic performance.

credits.title: Rematched
credits.overview: Two strangers sitting outside of a cafe are pulled into a young supernatural girl's illusion of reality, in an attempt for them to meet while being confronted by their deepest truths.

credits.title: Tinseltown High
credits.overview: [1950's] West Hollywood, CA: In a vintage bar and music lounge, a sharp-tongued woman named Linda gets caught in a hilarious mix-up when three men, all claiming the same identity, compete to make a shady deal.

credits.title: Unmatched
credits.overview: Charlie finds himself caught in a time loop inside a dream, reliving an awkward encounter again and again, each time hoping for a different outcome.

credits.title: Trajectoire
credits.overview: Montreal, June 2025: Clémence, a young emerging musical artist, discovers the existence of her twin brother Simon, separated from her at birth.
